title: User Login with Valid Credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using valid email and password.
steps: Verify that the user is redirected to the dashboard
Verify that the user's name or profile is visible
expected_result: User is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Dashboard Loading and Widget Visibility
description: Ensure the dashboard loads correctly and displays key widgets.
steps: Check for the presence of the 'Total Income' widget
Check for the presence of the 'Active Users' widget
Verify no error messages are displayed
expected_result: Dashboard loads with all key widgets visible.

title: View Customer List
description: Verify that the admin can view the list of customers.
steps: Verify that the customer table is displayed
Check that the table contains data rows
expected_result: Customer list is displayed with data.
